28600.meaning1: ending with life; limited to existence

examples.text: kāyapariyantikan'ti kāy'antikaṃ kāyaparicchinnaṃ, yāva pañcadvārakāyo pavattati, tāva pavattaṃ pañcadvārikavedanan'ti attho. jīvitapariyantikan'ti jīvit'antikaṃ jīvitaparicchinnaṃ, yāva jīvitaṃ pavattati, tāva pavattaṃ manodvārikavedanan'ti attho.

28601.meaning1: dependent on life; due to existence
28601.commentary: (MNa) saḷāyatanikan'ti saḷāyatanapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ. jīvitapaccayā'ti yāva jīvit'indriyānaṃ pavatti, tāva jīvitapaccayā pavattadarathamattā atthī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: so suññam'idaṃ saññāgataṃ ākiñcaññ'āyatanasaññāyā'ti pajānāti, suññam'idaṃ saññāgataṃ n'evasaññā-n'āsaññ'āyatanasaññāyā'ti pajānāti, atthi c'ev'idaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ, imam'eva kāyaṃ paṭicca saḷāyatanikaṃ jīvitapaccayā'ti.

28602.meaning1: requisites for life; necessities of existence

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'aṭṭho hoti appakicco subharo susantoso jīvitaparikkhāresu, app'āhāro hoti anodarikattaṃ anuyutto, appamiddho hoti jāgariyaṃ anuyutto
ye ca kho ime pabbajitena jīvitaparikkhārā samudānetabbā, cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārā, te kasirena samudāgacchanti.

28604.meaning1: limited to life; confined to existence

28605.meaning1: limited to life; ending with existence; confined to life

examples.text: jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idh'eva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantī'ti pajānāti.

28606.meaning1: exhaustion of one's life; using up one's lifespan

examples.text: kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idh'eva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantī'ti pajānāti.
yāv'assa kāyo ṭhassati tāva naṃ dakkhanti devamanussā kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā na naṃ dakkhanti devamanussā'ti

28607.meaning1: end of life; end of life span

examples.text: evaṃ mahāsatto khuddakamakkhikāya pivanamattam'pi lohitaṃ anuppādetvā satta rājāno palāpetvā kaniṭṭhabhātaraṃ apaloketvā kāme pahāya isipabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā abhiññā ca samāpattiyo ca nibbattetvā jīvitapariyosāne brahmalok'ūpago ahosi.
eso kho, deva, jiṇṇo nāma. na dāni tena ciraṃ jīvitabbaṃ bhavissatī'ti. kiṃ pana, samma sārathi, aham'pi jarādhammo, jaraṃ anatīto'ti?

28609.meaning1: one's own life; one's own existence

examples.text: ṭhānañ'hi so manuj'indo, rajjaṃ laddhāna khattiyo, so kuddho rājadaṇḍena, tasmiṃ pakkamate bhusaṃ, tasmā taṃ parivajjeyya, rakkhaṃ jīvitam'attano.
atthi, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ jīvite jīvitamado, yena madena mattā kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti, vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti, manasā duccaritaṃ caranti.
tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato yo jīvite jīvitamado so sabbaso vā pahīyati tanu vā pana hoti. idaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atthavasaṃ paṭicca maraṇadhammo'mhi, maraṇaṃ anatīto'ti

28611.meaning1: intoxicated with vanity of life; proud of one's existence
28611.meaningLit: intoxicated with the intoxication of life

examples.text: jīvitamadamatto vā, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati. so kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā, vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā, manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.

28612.meaning1: end of life by death; the very end of life

examples.text: thāmavā hoti yāva jīvitamaraṇapariyādānā thāmaṃ upadaṃsetā.

28613.commentary: (SNa) sīlaṃ jīvitam'uttaman'ti sīle patiṭṭhitassa jīvitaṃ uttaman'ti dasseti. atha vā… jīvitam'uttaman'ti etasmiṃ sīle ṭhitassa jīvitaṃ nāma uttamaṃ.

examples.text: kammaṃ vijjā ca dhammo ca, sīlaṃ jīvitam'uttamaṃ, etena maccā sujjhanti, na gottena dhanena vā.

28614.meaning1: end of life; loss of life

examples.text: atthamhi jātamhi sukhā sahāyā, tuṭṭhī sukhā yā itar'ītarena, puññaṃ sukhaṃ jīvitasaṅkhayamhi, sabbassa dukkhassa sukhaṃ pahānaṃ.

28615.meaning1: will to live; intention to live

28620.meaning1: for the sake of one's life; on account of one's life

examples.text: kathañ'ca, visākhe, mātugāmo bhattu manāpaṃ carati? idha, visākhe, mātugāmo yaṃ bhattu amanāpasaṅkhātaṃ taṃ jīvitahetu'pi na ajjhācarati. evaṃ kho, visākhe, mātugāmo bhattu manāpaṃ carati.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yaṃ mayā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ taṃ mama sāvakā jīvitahetu'pi n'ātikkamanti

28621.meaning1: leads one's life; conducts one's affairs; goes about one's business (with)

examples.text: micchājīvaṃ pahāya sammājīvena jīvitaṃ kappeti, etth'ete akusalā sīlā aparisesā nirujjhanti
idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako micchāājīvaṃ pahāya sammāājīvena jīvitaṃ kappeti, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sammāājīvo.

28622.commentary: (VIN 2.5.7.1) jīvitā voropeyyā'ti jīvit'indriyaṃ upacchindati uparodheti santatiṃ vikopeti

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, satthahārakaṃ v'āssa pariyeseyya, maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya
yadā kho, āvuso, tassa purisassa evam'assa, saṃvissattho kho my'āyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā'ti, atha naṃ rahogataṃ viditvā tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropeyya.

28623.grammar: idiom, nt + aor, aor of jīvitā voropeti (+acc)

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bāhiyaṃ dārucīriyaṃ iminā saṃkhittena ovādena ovaditvā pakkāmi. atha kho acirapakkantassa bhagavato bāhiyaṃ dārucīriyaṃ gāvī taruṇavacchā adhipatitvā jīvitā voropesi.

28624.meaning1: desire for (long) life; expectation of existence
28624.commentary: (ANa) āsā'ti taṇhā. duppajahā'ti duccajā dunnīharā. lābh'āsāya duppajahabhāvena sattā dasa'pi vassāni vīsati'pi saṭṭhi'pi vassāni ajja labhissāma, sve labhissāmā'ti rājānaṃ upaṭṭhahanti, kasikamm'ādīni karonti, ubhatobyūḷhaṃ saṅgāmaṃ pakkhandanti, ajapatha-saṅkupath'ādayo paṭipajjanti, nāvāya mahāsamuddaṃ pavisanti. jīvit'āsāya duppajahattā sampatte maraṇakāle'pi vassasatajīviṃ attānaṃ maññanti. so kammakammanimitt'ādīni passanto'pi dānaṃ dehi pūjaṃ, karohī'ti anukampakehi vuccamāno n'āhaṃ marissāmi, jīvissāmi'cc'eva āsāya kassaci vacanaṃ na gaṇhāti.

examples.text: lābh'āsā ca jīvit'āsā ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve āsā duppajahā'ti.

28625.meaning1: life faculty; life force; power of life
28625.commentary: (VINa) tattha duvidhaṃ jīvit'indriyaṃ, rūpajīvit'indriyaṃ, arūpajīvit'indriyañ'ca. tesu arūpajīvit'indriye upakkamo n'atthi, taṃ voropetuṃ na sakkā. rūpajīvit'indriye pana atthi, taṃ voropetuṃ sakkā.

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, maraṇaṃ? yaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā sattanikāyā cuti cavanatā bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccu maraṇaṃ kālakiriyā khandhānaṃ bhedo kaḷevarassa nikkhepo jīvit'indriyass'upacchedo, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, maraṇaṃ
jīvitā voropeyyā'ti jīvit'indriyaṃ upacchindati uparodheti santatiṃ vikopeti.

28626.commentary: (ADha) jīvitam'eva indriyaṃ jīvit'indriyaṃ. taṃ pavattasantat'ādhipateyyaṃ hoti. lakkhaṇ'ādīhi pana attanā avinibhuttānaṃ dhammānaṃ anupālanalakkhaṇaṃ jīvit'indriyaṃ, tesaṃ pavattanarasaṃ, tesaṃ'y'eva ṭhapanapaccupaṭṭhānaṃ

examples.text: jīvit'indriyaṃ, sukh'indriyaṃ, dukkh'indriyaṃ, somanass'indriyaṃ, domanass'indriyaṃ, upekkh'indriyaṃ

28628.meaning1: severing of the life faculty; cutting off existence

examples.text: yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā sattanikāyā cuti cavanatā bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccu maraṇaṃ kālaṃkiriyā khandhānaṃ bhedo, kaḷevarassa nikkhepo, jīvit'indriyass'upacchedo, idaṃ vuccat'āvuso, maraṇaṃ.

28629.meaning1: wishing to live; wanting to stay alive

examples.text: vāṇijo'va bhayaṃ maggaṃ, appasattho mahaddhano, visaṃ jīvitu'kāmo'va, pāpāni parivajjaye.
atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhappaṭikūlo

28630.meaning1: to live; to remain alive; to survive

examples.text: pārājiko hotī'ti seyyathā'pi nāma puriso sīsacchinno abhabbo tena sarīrabandhanena jīvituṃ, evam'eva bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo. tena vuccati, pārājiko hotī'ti.
atha naṃ piṇḍāya caritvā jīvituṃ samatthakāle sā kapālakaṃ hatthe ṭhapetvā.

bhoge laddhā sahadhammena yasaṃ laddhā saha ñātīhi saha upajjhāyehi ciraṃ jīvitvā dīgham'āyuṃ pāletvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjāmī'ti, ayaṃ catuttho dhammo iṭṭho kanto manāpo dullabho lokasmiṃ.

28632.meaning1: living a lifestyle of; living a life of; leading one's life

examples.text: kiṃ sū'dha vittaṃ purisassa seṭṭhaṃ, kiṃ su suciṇṇaṃ sukham'āvahāti, kiṃ su have sādutaraṃ rasānaṃ, kathaṃ jīviṃ jīvitam'āhu seṭṭhaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso vassasat'āyuko vassasatajīvī
uṭṭhānavato satīmato, sucikammassa nisammakārino, saññatassa dhammajīvino, appamattassa yaso'bhivaḍḍhati.
seyyathā'pi, bhante, juṇhapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, vaḍḍhat'eva vaṇṇena, vaḍḍhati maṇḍalena, vaḍḍhati ābhāya, vaḍḍhati ārohapariṇāhena
sace te, kassapa, agaru, viharemu aj'juṇho aggisālamhī'ti

28637.meaning1: bright half of the month; waxing fortnight

examples.text: chandā dosā bhayā mohā, yo dhammaṃ n'ātivattati, āpūrati yaso tassa, juṇhapakkh'eva candimā'ti.
api ca te ahaṃ, brahme, gatiñ'ca pajānāmi, jutiñ'ca pajānāmi, evaṃ mah'iddhiko bako brahmā, evaṃ mah'ānubhāvo bako brahmā, evaṃ mahesakkho bako brahmā'ti.
siddhatthaṃ lokapajjotaṃ, appameyyaṃ anopamaṃ, alatthaṃ paramaṃ pītiṃ, disvā dantaṃ jutin'dharaṃ.
sasāvakaṃ mahālābhiṃ, puññavantaṃ jutin'dharaṃ, ṭhapesi etadaggamhi, parisāsu visārado.
yesaṃ sambodhi'y'aṅgesu, sammā cittaṃ subhāvitaṃ, ādānapaṭinissagge, anupādāya ye ratā, khīṇ'āsavā jutimanto, te loke parinibbutā.

ko sujjhati muccati bajjhatī ca, ken'attanā gacchati brahmalokaṃ, ajānato me muni brūhi puṭṭho, bhagavā hi me sakkhi brahmajjadiṭṭho, tuvañ'hi no brahmasamo'si saccaṃ, kathaṃ upapajjati brahmalokaṃ jutima.

28645.meaning1: fact of being luminous; fact of being radiant; brilliance; magnificence

examples.text: tass'eva buddhassa sudhammatāya, sakkassa putto'mhi mah'ānubhāvo, mahājutīko tidiv'ūpapanno, jānanti maṃ idhā'pi gopako'ti.
chasahassā hemavatā, yakkhā nānattavaṇṇino, iddhimanto jutīmanto, vaṇṇavanto yasassino, modamānā abhikkāmuṃ, bhikkhūnaṃ samitiṃ vanaṃ.

28648.meaning1: makes an oblation; makes an offering

examples.text: saccena danto damasā upeto, ved'antagū vusitabrahmacariyo, yaññ'opanīto tam'upavhayetha, kālena so juhati dakkhiṇeyye'ti.
āsīsanti thomayanti abhijappanti juhanti, kām'ābhijappanti paṭicca lābhaṃ, te yājayogā bhavarāgarattā, n'ātariṃsu jātijaran'ti brūmi.

te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, santikammaṃ paṇidhikammaṃ bhūtakammaṃ bhūrikammaṃ vassakammaṃ vossakammaṃ vatthukammaṃ vatthuparikammaṃ ācamanaṃ nhāpanaṃ juhanaṃ vamanaṃ

28651.meaning1: having made an oblation; having made an offering (to)

examples.text: atha kho sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo aggiṃ juhitvā aggihuttaṃ paricaritvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā samantā catuddisā anuvilokesi, ko nu kho imaṃ habyasesaṃ bhuñjeyyā'ti? addasā kho sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle sasīsaṃ pārutaṃ nisinnaṃ.

28652.meaning1: makes an oblation; makes an offering

examples.text: yathā vā pan'eke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ jūtappamādaṭṭhān'ānuyogaṃ anuyuttā viharanti, seyyath'idaṃ, aṭṭhapadaṃ dasapadaṃ ākāsaṃ parihārapathaṃ santikaṃ khalikaṃ ghaṭikaṃ

examples.text: jūtappamādassa cha ādīnavā

28656.meaning2: engaging in gambling which is a basis for negligence

examples.text: yathā vā pan'eke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ jūtappamādaṭṭhān'ānuyogaṃ anuyuttā viharanti, seyyath'idaṃ, aṭṭhapadaṃ dasapadaṃ ākāsaṃ parihārapathaṃ santikaṃ khalikaṃ ghaṭikaṃ

28657.meaning2: particle used to address a slave woman or a woman of low grade

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, vedehikā gahapatānī kāḷiṃ dāsiṃ etadavoca, he je kāḷī'ti. kiṃ, ayye'ti? kiṃ, je, divā uṭṭhāsī'ti? na khv'ayye, kiñcī'ti.
dehi je ambapāli amhākaṃ etaṃ bhattaṃ satasahassenā'ti
kuḍḍamūlañ'ca nissāya, ālopaṃ taṃ abhuñjisaṃ, bhuñjamāne vā bhutte vā, jegucchaṃ me na vijjati.
asuci, bho kassapa, gūthakūpo asuci c'eva asucisaṅkhāto ca duggandho ca duggandhasaṅkhāto ca jeguccho ca jegucchasaṅkhāto ca paṭikūlo ca paṭikūlasaṅkhāto cā'ti.

tam'enaṃ uṭṭhahitvā apāpuritvā olokeyya. tassa sahadassanena amanāpatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, pāṭikulyatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, jegucchatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, jighacchitānam'pi na bhottu'kamyatā assa, pag'eva suhitānaṃ.

28661.meaning1: considered to be disgusting; regarded as repulsive

examples.text: asuci, bho kassapa, gūthakūpo asuci c'eva asucisaṅkhāto ca duggandho ca duggandhasaṅkhāto ca jeguccho ca jegucchasaṅkhāto ca paṭikūlo ca paṭikūlasaṅkhāto cā'ti.

tam'enaṃ uṭṭhahitvā apāpuritvā olokeyya. tassa sahadassanena amanāpatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, pāṭikulyatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, jegucchitā ca saṇṭhaheyya, jighacchitānam'pi na bhottu'kamyatā assa, pag'eva suhitānaṃ.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gaṇḍo anekavassagaṇiko. tass'assu gaṇḍassa nava vaṇamukhāni nava abhedanamukhāni. tato yaṃ kiñci pagghareyya, asuci'y'eva pagghareyya, duggandhaṃ'y'eva pagghareyya, jegucchiyaṃ'y'eva pagghareyya.

28664.meaning1: who is disgusted; who hates (to); who detests; recoiling (from)

examples.text: atthi khv'esa, brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya, jegucchī samaṇo gotamo'ti.
jegucchī hoti uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā abhinisīdituṃ vā abhinipajjituṃ vā.

28665.meaning1: scrupulous in morality; who avoids harming any living being; (comm) who is disgusted by evil
28665.notes: refers to extreme harmlessness towards other living beings

examples.text: jegucchī nipako bhikkhu, cātuyāmasusaṃvuto, diṭṭhaṃ sutañ'ca ācikkhaṃ, na hi nūna kibbisī siyā'ti.

abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ, sāriputta, caturaṅgasamannāgataṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritā, tapassī sudaṃ homi paramatapassī, lūkho sudaṃ homi paramalūkho, jegucchī sudaṃ homi paramajegucchī, pavivitto sudaṃ homi paramapavivitto.
jeṭṭho bhavaṃ gotamo seṭṭho bhavaṃ gotamo
mātari pitari c'āpi, atho jeṭṭhamhi bhātari. ācariye catutthamhi, tesu na mānaṃ kayirātha.

28667.meaning1: name of a lunar month; May-June

examples.text: so pana vassāno utu sāvaṇapoṭṭhapādamāsā, assayujakattikamāsā sarado, māgasiraphussamāsā hemanto, māghaphaggunamāsā sisiro, cittavesākhamāsā vasanto, jeṭṭha-āsaḷhamāsā gimho utū'ti veditabbo.
abhibhū'ti abhibhavitvā ṭhito jeṭṭhako'ham'asmī'ti. anabhibhūto'ti aññehi anabhibhūto.
bhūtapubbaṃ, ambaṭṭha, rājā okkāko yā sā mah'esī piyā manāpā, tassā puttassa rajjaṃ pariṇāmetu'kāmo jeṭṭhakumāre raṭṭhasmā pabbājesi, okkāmukhaṃ karakaṇḍaṃ hatthinikaṃ sinisūraṃ.

atha kho, ānanda, rājā maghadevo kappakassa gāmavaraṃ datvā jeṭṭhaputtaṃ kumāraṃ āmantāpetvā etadavoca, pātubhūtā kho me, tāta kumāra, devadūtā, dissanti sirasmiṃ palitāni jātāni, bhuttā kho pana me mānusakā kāmā, samayo dibbe kāme pariyesituṃ.
aparesam'pi dasannaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati, jeṭṭhabhātu, kaniṭṭhabhātu, jeṭṭhabhaginiyā, kaniṭṭhabhaginiyā, cūḷamātuyā, mahāmātuyā, cūḷapituno, mahāpituno, pitucchāya, mātulassā'ti.
aparesam'pi dasannaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati, jeṭṭhabhātu, kaniṭṭhabhātu, jeṭṭhabhaginiyā, kaniṭṭhabhaginiyā, cūḷamātuyā, mahāmātuyā, cūḷapituno, mahāpituno, pitucchāya, mātulassā'ti.

28680.commentary: (DNa) na kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyitā'ti kule jeṭṭhānaṃ apacitiyā nīcavuttiyā akaraṇabhāvo.

examples.text: aḍḍhateyyavassasat'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu ime dhammā vepullam'agamaṃsu. amatteyyatā apetteyyatā asāmaññatā abrahmaññatā na kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyitā.

28681.meaning1: honouring elders; paying respect to seniors (in)
28681.commentary: (SNa) kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyī'ti kulajeṭṭhakānaṃ mahāpitā mahāmātā cūḷapitā cūḷamātā mātulo mātulānīti'ādīnaṃ apacitikārako.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā nānābāhāsu gahetvā yamassa rañño dassenti, ayaṃ, deva, puriso amatteyyo apetteyyo asāmañño abrāhmañño, na kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyī. imassa devo daṇḍaṃ paṇetū'ti.

28682.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: jeto jayanto padumo uppalo ca, padum'uttaro rakkhito pabbato ca, mānatthaddho sobhito vītarāgo, kaṇho ca buddho suvimuttacitto.
idañ'hi taṃ jetavanaṃ, isisaṅghanisevitaṃ, āvutthaṃ dhammarājena, pītisañjananaṃ mama.

28685.commentary: (SNa) jetāraṃ labhate jayan'ti jayanto puggalo pacchā jetāram'pi labhati.

examples.text: hantā labhati hantāraṃ, jetāraṃ labhate jayaṃ, akkosako ca akkosaṃ, rosetārañ'ca rosako, atha kammavivaṭṭena, so vilutto viluppatī'ti.

28686.meaning1: name of a monastery in Sāvatthī
28686.commentary: (MNa) tassaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ. jetavane'ti ettha attano paccatthikajanaṃ jinātī'ti jeto, raññā vā attano paccatthikajane jite jāto'ti jeto, maṅgalakamyatāya vā tassa evaṃnāmam'eva katan'ti jeto, jetassa vanaṃ jetavanaṃ. tañ'hi jetena rājakumārena ropitaṃ saṃvaddhitaṃ paripālitaṃ, so ca tassa sāmī ahosi. tasmā jetavanan'ti vuccati, tasmiṃ jetavane. anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme'ti

examples.text: idañ'hi taṃ jetavanaṃ, isisaṅghanisevitaṃ, āvutthaṃ dhammarājena, pītisañjananaṃ mama.
atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami

28688.commentary: (JAa) sādhum'pi sādhunā jetī'ti ye sādhū sappurisā, te sayam'pi sādhu hutvā sādhunāva upāyena jināti.

examples.text: tass'eva tena pāpiyo, yo kuddhaṃ paṭikujjhati, kuddhaṃ appaṭikujjhanto, saṅgāmaṃ jeti dujjayaṃ.
daḷhaṃ daḷhassa khipati, balliko mudunā muduṃ, sādhum'pi sādhunā jeti, asādhum'pi asādhunā, etādiso ayaṃ rājā, maggā uyyāhi sārathi.
na tattha hatthīnaṃ bhūmi, na rathānaṃ na pattiyā, na c'āpi mantayuddhena, sakkā jetuṃ dhanena vā.

28690.meaning1: having conquered; having defeated; having overcome

examples.text: sa ve indriyasampanno, santo santipade rato, dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ, jetvā māraṃ savāhinin'ti.
haṃs'ādiccapathe yanti, ākāse yanti iddhiyā, nīyanti dhīrā lokamhā, jetvā māraṃ savāhiniṃ.
jetvāna maccuno senaṃ, anāgantvā punabbhavaṃ, samūlaṃ taṇham'abbuyha, godhiko parinibbuto'ti.
namo te puris'ājañña, yo tvaṃ dujjayam'ajjhabhū, jetvāna maccuno senaṃ, vimokkhena anāvaraṃ.

28695.meaning1: should conquer; could defeat; could overcome

examples.text: yo sahassaṃ sahassena, saṅgāme mānuse jine, ekañ'ca jeyya'm'attānaṃ, sa ve saṅgāmaj'uttamo, attā have jitaṃ seyyo, yā c'āyaṃ itarā pajā.

28698.meaning1: will conquer; will defeat; will beat

examples.text: añña'd'atthu sissaṃ musilaṃ ācariya tvam'eva jessasi
